title: Streetlights not working near school
description: Three streetlights on the road in front of the primary school have been off for over a week. The road is completely dark after 6 PM and children returning from evening tuition classes have to walk in the dark. There was also an accident last night when a scooter hit a stray dog.
location: Gandhi Nagar Main Road, near Government Primary School
aiSummary: Multiple non-functional streetlights creating hazardous dark conditions near Government Primary School.
aiReasoning: The issue involves malfunctioning public streetlights, placing it in 'Street Lighting'. The priority is designated as 'High' due to complete darkness near a school zone posing significant safety risks to children and having already contributed to an accident.

title: Deep crater-like pothole causing vehicle damage
description: Large pothole about 2 feet wide on the main road right in front of the government hospital. Multiple two-wheelers have skidded and damaged their tires.
aiSummary: Large 2-foot pothole on Main Hospital Road causing vehicle damage and two-wheeler skidding.
aiReasoning: Classified under Road & Potholes as it involves road surface deterioration. High priority is warranted because it poses a significant traffic safety risk directly in front of a major hospital entrance.

title: Open storm drain without safety slab on primary school route
description: Concrete cover slab broke and fell into the storm drainage canal. The open pit is approximately 5 feet deep with sharp rebar edges, situated directly along the walking route to the primary school.
location: Road No. 36, Near Oakridge School, Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad
aiSummary: Uncovered deep storm drain trench poses immediate fall hazard to schoolchildren.
aiReasoning: Critical rating due to direct threat of severe physical injury or fatal falls for young pedestrians walking along this route.

title: Overflowing garbage dump attracting stray animals and blocking sidewalk
description: A large pile of uncollected domestic and commercial waste has spilled across the pedestrian walkway near the main market. Stray animals are scattering plastic and organic waste, creating strong foul odors and walking hazards.
aiSummary: Major uncollected waste heap blocking sidewalk near residential apartments.
aiReasoning: High sanitation and hygiene risk due to animal scavenging and foot-traffic obstruction near homes.

title: Exposed underground power cables sparked after rain near bus stop
description: Heavy rains exposed underground electrical junction cables right next to the crowded commuter bus stop shelter. Commuters reported loud snapping sparks and smoke coming from the damp soil.
location: Opposite Bus Stop, S.V. Road, Andheri West, Mumbai
aiSummary: Exposed live electrical wiring sparking near high-traffic commuter bus shelter.
aiReasoning: Critical life safety hazard due to electrocution danger in a pedestrian corridor during wet weather.

title: Drinking water main pipeline burst gushing thousands of liters
description: A 6-inch primary municipal potable water pipeline ruptured underneath the road shoulder. Clean drinking water is shooting up into the air and flooding the roadway, dropping tap water pressure for the surrounding colony.
location: Near Usman Road Flyover, T. Nagar, Chennai
aiSummary: Ruptured 6-inch freshwater supply line flooding street and wasting drinking water.
aiReasoning: High urgency due to large-scale municipal clean water loss and disruption to local neighborhood water supply.

title: Multiple street lights dead creating complete blackout on residential lane
description: Four consecutive sodium streetlamps on Lane 5 are not lighting up at night. The 200-meter stretch is in pitch blackness, causing safety concerns for women and elderly residents returning home after dark.
aiSummary: Four consecutive non-functional streetlights causing dark stretch of 200 meters.
aiReasoning: Medium priority for pedestrian security concerns after sunset in a quiet residential sector.

title: Raw sewage backflow from clogged inspection chamber onto main walkway
description: Inspection chamber overflowed during peak morning hours, spreading foul effluent onto the paved footpath near the metro station staircase. Municipal suction truck was dispatched to clear the silt blockage.
location: Sector 1, Near Karunamoyee Metro, Salt Lake, Kolkata
aiSummary: Sanitary sewer overflow jet-cleaned and cleared by municipal suction truck.
aiReasoning: High public health hazard with foul effluent overflowing into a high-footfall metro transit zone.

title: Series of dangerous asphalt depressions and potholes after monsoon showers
description: Multiple potholes formed on the downhill turn near Goodluck Cafe. Two-wheelers were frequently skidding on loose gravel. Road repair crew deployed cold asphalt patching.
location: FC Road, Near Goodluck Cafe, Shivajinagar, Pune
aiSummary: Cluster of asphalt potholes patched and resurfaced with bitumen mix.
aiReasoning: Road deterioration causing vehicle bumper scrapes and reduced traffic flow during peak hours.

title: Faded pedestrian zebra crossing marks and damaged directional sign board
description: White reflective zebra crossing paint has completely worn off over time, making it hard for vehicles to see pedestrian crossings. The overhead direction signboard is also tilting.
location: Outer Circle, Near Block C, Connaught Place, New Delhi
aiSummary: Repainting of weathered pedestrian crossing lines and straightened directional signage.
aiReasoning: Low safety urgency; routine road maintenance and cosmetic civic infrastructure upkeep.
